press_references.value: Dashlane Launches Global Partner Program to Transform Credential Security for Enterprises

product_launches.description: Dashlane launches a comprehensive, tiered partner program to empower reseller partners in addressing credential-based threats and providing frictionless access across customer environments.

press_references.value: This Password Manager Caught Some of Its Own Employees Not Using Its Product

overview_description.description: Dashlane is a leading credential manager that removes complexity by pairing comprehensive security with ease of use. We are closely attuned to the needs of our users, balancing simple tools with an uncompromising approach to security–a game changer for anyone, but especially for IT admins working to secure their organization. Our team in Paris, New York, and Lisbon is united by a strong sense of community and passion for improving the digital experience. Over 22,000 businesses and 19M users globally use Dashlane for a faster, simpler, and more secure internet.

about_short_description.short_description: Dashlane is a leading credential manager that removes complexity by pairing comprehensive security with ease of use.

product.name: Dashlane Omnix™ platform
product.description: A credential security platform that combines password management with browser-based credential risk detection, employee alerts, remediation, and visibility into logins outside SSO.

product.name: Dashlane Credential Protection
product.description: A browser-based credential security product that detects password risks and phishing threats, then provides real-time employee alerts and remediation even when employees do not use a Dashlane vault.

product.name: Dashlane Business Password Management
product.description: An enterprise password manager that provides encrypted employee vaults, secure credential sharing, passkey storage, and centralized administrative controls for access, policies, reporting, and provisioning.

product.name: Dashlane Personal Password Manager
product.description: A password manager for individuals that stores and autofills passwords, passkeys, payment information, and other personal credentials across computers and mobile devices.

product.name: Dashlane Family Password Manager
product.description: A password management plan for households that helps family members store, autofill, share, and manage passwords and other credentials across their devices.
